description: The composite controls of SvGrid UI in Svelte 5: SvTabs in line and pill styles with a roving keyboard, SvTree with expand and collapse, single selection and cascading tri-state checkboxes, and a schema-driven SvForm that wires the rest of the kit, inputs, select, switch, date and textarea, with required and custom validation in a two-column layout.

faq.question: How does the form know which component to render?
faq.answer: From each field's type in the schema: text, select, switch, date and textarea map to the kit components, and initial seeds the values.

faq.question: How do cascading checkboxes work in the tree?
faq.answer: Checking a folder checks its children and partially checked folders show the indeterminate state; onCheck reports the full set of checked ids.

faq.question: How are the tabs and panels linked?
faq.answer: tabs is an array of { id, label } and value is the active id; the panel for that id renders below, and arrow keys move focus between tabs with automatic activation.
